hypothesis: On the corrected r5b parent, CPADC's causal correction direction retains useful residual information but the deployed step is too large; a scalar train-only line search will therefore choose a mean step below 1 and improve over the parent.
mechanism: A one-dimensional trust-region line search separates direction quality from correction amplitude, following regularized system-identification practice without changing the deployed algorithm in this diagnostic.
failure_signal: No epoch obtains at least 1 percent oracle improvement, fewer than one third of episodes have a positive step, or the mean oracle step is above 0.5.
rollback: The oracle never changes gradients, checkpoints, or deployment outputs; reject the shrinkage hypothesis if its gate fails.
